credits.title: Sana, Sana
credits.overview: Arturo Jurado, a journalist whose investigation brings him back to his small, East LA, hometown, his story becomes intertwined with the past he left behind.

credits.title: Hollow Bedrooms
credits.overview: On a bleak Tuesday night in Los Angeles, stories of love, shame, addiction and fear interweave.

credits.title: 40Hands
credits.overview: Yet another quiet Friday night at home until Samantha discovers a young party boy crying in her courtyard, broken-hearted, with beer bottles duct taped to his hands.

credits.title: Young Mr. Lucas
credits.overview: A disheartened filmmaker hosts a friends and family screening of his latest project.

credits.title: It Ends
credits.overview: A group of recent grads head out on a late night drive for grub, hoping to enjoy one final hangout before their paths diverge. credits.title: Senior Prank
credits.overview: When their senior prank goes wildly off the rails, four students scramble to fix the mess, dodge authority, and survive the most chaotic day of their high school lives.

credits.title: Ojai
credits.overview: Ricky and his cancer-stricken mother move to the seemingly innocuous town of Ojai in pursuit of a vague yet promising experimental treatment. As Ricky tries to adjust to his new life, he becomes increasingly skeptical of the town's innocence and concerned for his mom's well-being.

credits.title: Unfix
credits.overview: After a brief encounter with another boy at age 11, Ari Wallenmeier is forced to undergo Conversion Therapy. Now 35 years old and “fixed", Ari contemplates marriage with his long-time partner and fiancée Ava. But when the pandemic hits, isolation and stress rekindles old feelings and Ari is determined to face them.

credits.title: Mandrake
credits.overview: Max attends a party in hopes of running into his longtime crush. Things get complicated when her arrogant ex-boyfriend shows up with similar intentions. Passions erupt into violence, and mild-mannered Max learns just what he's capable of.

credits.title: The Breakdown
credits.overview: A nerdy high school jazz band embarks on a journey to California for an international band competition. Their bus breaks down and they are forced to stay at a motel overnight. Bored, they decide to have an orgy.

credits.title: Hanger's Limb
credits.overview: After surviving a brutal amputation during the Civil War, James Hanger returns home emotionally and physically broken. In order to survive his depression, he designs and builds the first prosthetic leg with knee and ankle joints.
